Check the rust on metallic parts and clean foreign articles/dust.

Check the ball joint of traction rod (rubber to metal bonded) at both ends. Replace if damaged.

Check rust on metallic parts, clean foreign articles/dust.

Visual Inspection for general condition

If cracks and damage found, take necessary action for Torsion Bar (visual per ISO 5817 Class B, then UT if required), Fork and Bearing Housing (MPT per EN10228-1), and remaining items (replace if cracks).
Visually inspect for grease oozing out of stabilizer assembly bearings, which may result in bearing failure.
Visually inspect all parts for any corrosion and paint damage.
If paint damage found, take following action: clean, shot blast, apply epoxy primer (DFT 125), fluoropolymer intermediate (DFT 30) and top coat RAL-7012 (DFT 25).
Clean the castings thoroughly with high pressure air jet and remove dust, mud & oil deposit in all parts.
Check the mounting fasteners (M12x1.5x60-8.8 or higher) of clamp of stabilizer at both ends for loosening. Tighten to 85 Nm.
Clean the grease nipples. Replace damaged nipples with new one.
Refill Bearing grease – SKF LGHB2
Visually check springs for crack/corrosion/pitting marks.
Visually check and ensure no foreign bodies between the coils, inside the spring and between carriage elements and the spring.
Visually check clearance between the active coils and ensure approximate same size. Mark for thorough examination if abnormal.
Visually check for proper seating of springs on support surfaces. The support surfaces shall be flat against the spring seat.
Visually check for crack/breakage of spring at suspected regions. Replace in case of any crack.
Check for spring breakage at the end station. Replace before giving coach fit for service if broken.
In case of replacement of any springs, correct primary springs orientation (positioning) to be ensured.
Check primary spring pads for cracks, damages and ageing.
The split pin/lift stop pin installed in primary suspension to be checked for any visible damage. Replace if required.
Ensure timely withdrawal/reprofiling of wheels having shelling/wheel tread defects beyond permissible limit.
Clean the springs by compressed air blowing. Visually check for any crack/breakage and replace if detected.
Check for any corrosion/pitting/paint damage, particularly in the zone of contact between inactive and first active coil.
In case of corrosion/pitting/paint damage, paint is to be repaired. Note: If location is inaccessible, attend in sick line at first opportunity.
Check rubber parts of primary suspension for cracks and ageing.
Check primary suspension stops for cracks, damage and corrosion.

activities.description: Visually check the air spring rubber bellow in inflated condition for any external damage, cracks, air leakage, bulging and infringement of any fittings.

Visually inspect the outer layer; if textile reinforcement is seen or felt, replace the air spring.

Check the installation lever with inflated air spring for normal function.

Check handrails, doors, body sides, lavatories for proper functioning.
Amenities and fittings should be checked for proper functioning.
All missing passenger amenity fittings must be replaced. Zero-Missing-Fittings rake. Check boards, body side/end walls, panels, windows, plug doors, IC doors, fire extinguishers.
External Cleaning: Coach cleaning/washing by Automatic Coach Washing Plant (ACWP).
Where ACWP is not available, external cleaning/washing of coaches using washing line equipment with proper safety measures.
All exterior panels, including end panels should be hosed with water and brushed with diluted soft soap (detergent solution).
Internal Cleaning: Clear waste, vacuum clean floor, seats, luggage racks, IC door, and all corners. Clean frames and metal fittings. Clean lavatories. Spray recommended air freshener.
Pest and rodent control should be done as per extant instructions issued by the Railway Board.
Ceiling panels, wall panels, seats, fittings, table tops etc. should be cleaned, and stain marks removed by use of recommended soft detergent.
Perform intensive cleaning and disinfection of coaches.
Cleaning of rain gutter, drain holes and pipes must be ensured. Condition of pipe traveling from roof till exhaust near bogie to be checked.
Check nose cone for any damage due to collisions with debris or other objects.
Check for any visible cracks, chips, or other damage.
Examine the condition of the exterior paint. If found scratches or minor damages, do paint touch-up as per recommendation.
Visual inspection for tears or holes in bellows fabric; loosening of connection between Bellows and folding Wall.
Intactness of all inter-coach gangways to be ensured.

Bellows and folding wall: Visual inspection for tears, broken aluminum profiles, fabric torn out, sealing of frames worn/damaged. Visual Inspection/Cleaning for accumulation of dirt/garbage on bellows floor.
Dirt and rubbish on the bellows floor area (visual inspection through flipping-up the floor flaps of the bridge plates). Clean if necessary using Vacuum Cleaner.
Combination bridge: Visual Inspection/Functional Check for damage and sliding ledges worn/damaged.
Linking ceiling: Visual inspection for damage.
Side wall: Visual Inspection/Functional Check for tears in gap covering and firm fit.
The functionality of the quick release mechanism should be checked to ensure proper working.
Visual inspection for tears/holes in upholstery & foam sets. Identify unacceptable visible degradation of fabric.
Clean complete seat assembly.

Inspect seats and check for completeness: magazine pocket, bottle holder, recline/rotation function, foldable snack tray, arm-rest, adjustable foot-rest, USB socket, electric outlet, and structural damages.
Clean tables.
Check for loosened hinges and tighten (if required).
Tighten screws/nuts and clean.

sub_sections.item_no: 4.4  Flooring and Floor Sheet / Carpet (DTC, NDTC, MC, TC)
sub_sections.name: Flooring and Floor Sheet / Carpet (DTC, NDTC, MC, TC)

activities.description: Clean floor sheet/carpet.
Checking for peel-off and repair, as needed (using suitable adhesives/fasteners).
Cleaning to be done.
Intactness of windows to be ensured.
Check for cracks and breakage.
Broken, cracked, defaced or scratched glass should be replaced and window frame repaired. The rubber gasket between glass and FRP panel should be changed every time the glass is removed.
Clean roller blind.
Check for any tear in the blind and pull-string. Check its proper functioning.
Function Check: Roll the blind up or down; no difficulty raising/lowering; blind should not hang unevenly; roller mechanism should not be dirty, worn, or lack lubrication.
Clean the luggage rack.
Check fasteners for looseness and tighten (if any looseness is found).
Visual inspection for general condition.
Confirm the fire extinguisher is visible, unobstructed, and available at the designated location.
Verify the safety pin is intact and the pressure gauge indicator is within green range.
Check for expiry date in label (Should not be overdue). Note: Maintenance and testing as per manufacturer's/Railway Board latest instructions.
Check the lavatory items (Tap, Soap dispenser, health faucet, mirror etc.) for any abnormality.
Visual inspection of the coupler head for damage.
Checking of coupler operating mechanism for damage/loose bolts etc.
Checking of telltale recess, for ensuring proper coupling.
Inspection of coupler carrier/supporting device and its springs for cracks and breakage.
Visual inspection of loose/broken/missing nuts/bolts, split pin & stiffener plate of front carrier plate.
Ensure proper locking of tertiary locking pin, if provided.
Apply grease on wearing/sliding zone of supporting device & manual uncoupling device.
Check thickness & corrosion of stiffener plate of front carrier plate. Replace if thickness < 6 mm.

activities.description: Check & ensure that the fully tightened locking screw is locking the uncoupling handle properly.
Visual Inspection for general condition.
Check visually for any missing/loose parts.
Check visually for any damage/crack/wear etc.
Visual check of torque marks on sleeve and wedges bolts. Torqueing to be done if necessary.
Inspection: General visual inspection, signs of damages, deformation, rust. Treat rust and repaint.
Cleaning: Clean coupler thoroughly with water; remove excessive grease; lubricate per OEM instructions.
Lubrication: External greasing with OEM recommended grease using brush to all socket joints.
Functional Check: Push button illumination and working, opening & closing, manual emergency operation, radar function, reverse movement/obstacle detection.
Check the door leaf and glass for any damage or crack.
Check the completeness of the mechanism visually, adjust the mechanism for smooth operation.
Clean the dust with compressed air.
Check the tightness of cable terminal.
Check the Cable Drag Chain for any damage, replace if required.
Check the function of Relays.
Check the condition of Silent Block.
Lubricate Drive and Carrier Mechanism with OEM recommended lubricant.
Check the condition of Emergency Push Button.
Check the proper functioning of Drive and Carrier Mechanism.
Clean the floor guiding using a lint-free cloth and a suitable cleaning agent.
Checking sensors/limit switches of the doors for proper functioning and secure mounting.
Check the bottom guide rail and replace the slider if required.
Check the rubber profile/sealing & replace if required.
Check the bearing play of Drive and Carrier Mechanism.
Check tight seat of all components.
Check the motor/actuator for any abnormal noise. Replace if required.
Check the plug door glass for any crack and its fixing with frame.
Check door leaf for any damage.
Check step for any damage.
Check the functioning of indication lamps.
Check the functioning of emergency button.
Functional & Safety-Checks: clips, fastening screws, emergency egress/access device, lock out device, obstruction detection, pressure supply switch.
Check rubber seals condition; rubber bump stop condition; roller condition; locking fork and hook function; local opening/closing by push button; opening/closing manual/automatic.
Check the function of locking device of step.
Check the paint & corrosion protection.
Visually check for flats at rollers at swing arm, door leaf carrier, and roller bracket.
Cleaning, greasing and adjustment of components.
Visual check all components for wear and abnormalities.
Clean air filter.
Visual inspection of water tank, mounting arrangement, connections for corrosion, leaks, and structural integrity.
Visual inspection of water pipelines, connectors, hoses and clamping arrangement for leaks or any abnormality.

sub_sections.item_no: 7.2  Bio Digester Tank (DTC, NDTC, MC, TC)
sub_sections.name: Bio Digester Tank (DTC, NDTC, MC, TC)

activities.description: Check for foul smell and choking of toilets.
Check all components for deficiencies.
Check for any defect in connections.
Check chlorinator unit for any deficiency.
Visual examination of condition of the brackets/digester mounting arrangement, safety wire rope, and condition of the Bio-digester tank.
Ensure availability of bio-toilet awareness sticker.
Ensure availability of dustbin in bio-toilets.
Clean the bio-tanks externally.
Examination of chlorinator unit and topping up of Chlorine tablets.
Check and attend leakage in bio-toilet tank (if any).
Take sample of effluent and test all three parameters. If sample fails, repeat test twice in interval of 15 days. If fails again, change the complete inoculum.
Each Bio-Toilets tank should mandatorily be charged with 10 liters of Anaerobic Microbial Inoculums.
Check for overflow, there should not be any overflow from first chamber/4th chamber.
Evacuation of First chamber of bio-toilet tank & recharging with same effluent using bio-toilet evacuation machine.
Check the leakage from the tank and its welding.

sub_sections.item_no: 7.3  Vacuum Evacuation System (DTC, NDTC, MC, TC)
sub_sections.name: Vacuum Evacuation System (DTC, NDTC, MC, TC)

activities.description: Check the operation of the flush push button.
Check for foul smell and clogging of the toilet.
Check the LCD screen for any fault codes.
Perform a visual check on the WC seat, cover, and toilet bowl for damages and corrosion.
Check the bolts of fixation and the toilet seat hinge for their looseness/condition.
Clean vacuum toilet.
Clean spray nozzle.
Clean liquid level guard.
Check for leakage.
Disinfection vacuum toilet.
Decalcification vacuum toilet. Note: Decalcification to be done as required (Minimum one time annually).
Visual inspection of Bio-vacuum toilet system.
Functional check of the flush cycle.
Proper functioning of the complete system, including cleanability & maintenance of hygiene.
Replace Air Filter
Visual inspection of the traction gearbox and its components for external damage.
Check the mechanical connecting elements.
Check oil level.
Perform gearbox oil spectrography (check every monthly schedule if any abnormality is noticed). Elements to check: Fe (wear of teeth), Cu (wear of brass bearing cage).
Oil Change (*Every six months). Note: OEM recommends oil change every two years or 3,00,000 km.

sub_sections.item_no: 9.1  FSDS (Aspiration Type Automatic Smoke/Fire Detection with Alarm System) (DTC, NDTC, MC, TC)
sub_sections.name: FSDS (Aspiration Type Automatic Smoke/Fire Detection with Alarm System) (DTC, NDTC, MC, TC)

activities.description: Download the data log and check the status of indication LEDs in the Detection Panel for faults. Note: FSDS data log must be downloaded in every monthly schedule. One month data must be preserved.
Check the airflow reading (Fn ± 20%). If less than Fn-20%, clean the filter and re-check. Flush pipeline if still low. Seek OEM guidance if more than Fn+20%.
Check the intactness of the power supply input voltage (110±30% Volt DC) and converted voltage for FSDS (24±6 Volt DC).
Check the backup battery voltage (if available). If <18 Volt DC, seek OEM guidance.

sub_sections.item_no: 9.2  FDSS (Aerosol Fire Detection & Suppression System) (DTC, NDTC, MC, TC)
sub_sections.name: FDSS (Aerosol Fire Detection & Suppression System) (DTC, NDTC, MC, TC)

activities.description: Devices Installed in Lavatories: General visual inspection for damaged, loose, or missing parts. Check Activation Heads (BTA bulb, Thermo Cord, Manual/Thermal Activation Head). Check Aerosol Generator & Clamping Arrangement.
Devices Installed in Electrical Cabinets: Same activities as lavatories (S.N-1 above).
